From: Maya Kline <maya.kline@novacare.com>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Authorization cartography request (SOC2/SIG)

Hi Hannah,

We're preparing for a SIG intake (Novacare / ProcureX) next week and need a compact authorization cartography pack from Redwood to feed into our evaluator. To limit follow-up questions, could you supply the following artifacts by EOD Thursday (8/6):

- Role-to-permission mapping (CSV) with an owner column and last-modified timestamp; indicate service accounts vs human principals.
- Representative SAML assertion sample(s) for a typical user sign-in, sanitized to remove PII (timestamps ok).
- SCIM delta export (last 90 days) or a short snippet that demonstrates create/update/delete event types for users and groups.
- Short readme (one paragraph) that explains how RBAC roles map to product features and any dynamic entitlements.

If you have an internal owner list or a single point of contact for authorization provenance we can reference that will speed validation. Also let us know if anything needs redaction for customer names or tenant IDs — we'll accept redacted artifacts as long as mapping logic is preserved.

Thanks — we appreciate a quick turnaround on this.

Best,
Maya
Maya Kline
Security & Privacy Manager
Novacare Health

Hi Maya — thanks for the patience. Please find the authorization cartography pack attached and summarized below. I've redacted tenant identifiers and customer names where necessary; attachments include short notes explaining redaction choices.

Attached artifacts (also uploaded to the shared Drive link):
- redacted-rbac-owner-map.csv (CSV with columns: role_id, role_name, permission_list, owner_email(redacted), last_modified_iso, service_account_flag)
- saml-assertion-sample-sanitized.txt (single representative assertion; timestamps preserved; NameID and email attributes anonymized; comment header explains fields kept)
- scim-delta-90d-snippet.json (JSONL, last 90 days window, includes create/update/delete lines with user_id anonymized; event type and attribute diffs preserved)

Notes/assumptions:
- Service accounts included are those with a `service_account_flag` of TRUE in the CSV; we did not include ephemeral API keys or secret material.
- The SCIM snippet intentionally omits full email addresses and tenant GUIDs; we replaced with consistent pseudonyms so mapping logic is intact for validation.
- SAML sample keeps assertion structure and claim names so evaluators can verify attribute mappings; we removed PII and replaced tenant-specific entityID with a placeholder.

If you prefer a zipped bundle with full SCIM deltas under a FedRAMP-style data handling agreement, we can coordinate a secure transfer and a narrow timeframe.

Would you like a 30-minute walkthrough of the artifacts on Friday 8/7 or early next week? I can include Jordan and Rishi for technical details.

Regards,

Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
